note: Stanton city park in cottonwood woods on the west bank of the Knife River, near its mouth on the Missouri; Knife River Indian Villages National Historic Site is just north of town. Only two of the RV spots have electric and water; the showers take quarters. --Claude
summary: City park page: 10 RV spots + host, 2 pads with electric + water ('110'), $20 RV / $10 tent, cash/check drop box, first-come only, mid-May-Sep, coin showers. Google 4.7 (32). Not waterfront stands (sites in woods 80 m+ from the river). Pin ok. Website -> city page; phone add 701-745-3202 (city office).
